lines.text:
The Fuchsia City Gym is a tricked-up place.
It’s riddled with invisible walls!\c
Koga might look within reach, sure...
but it’s not always that easy!\c
You’ll have to find the gaps in the walls if you
hope to reach him for a battle.
It’s amazing how terrifying ninjas can be, even\ntoday in the modern age!
